original_target.title: Additivity of entanglement of purification
original_target.outcome: Claim: nonadditivity claim with exact finite artifact replay; complete analytic reduction awaiting independent review.

answer: Negative: ordinary von Neumann entanglement of purification is nonadditive.
required_status_qualification: Complete resolution of the stated target in the cited source.
scope_comparison: Theorem1 claims E_P^infty(W)<97/100<E_P(W) for the ordinary von Neumann two-qubit Werner state W at1/200. Thus some finite k has E_P(W^k)<k E_P(W). Choose the least such k: equality holds at k-1 and the pair rho=W^(k-1),sigma=W gives the required strict binary additivity failure with party grouping AC:BD. The argument does not identify k=2. The ancilla reduction includes complex purifications with each ancilla at most rank4. Prior local finite certificate replay is evidence only for arithmetic; the analytic proof remains unverified.
